title: 香蕉棒球Jesse Cole：35美元看球无手续费，自建二手市场打击黄牛
speaker: Jesse Cole

segments.en: Jesse I got to tell you what I love about it is the price point because you make it affordable for families. I mean, I got to admit I go to a Yankee game
segments.zh: Jesse，我得说我喜欢的是价格，你让家庭负担得起。我承认我去看洋基队的比赛……

segments.en: So how do you keep it at that price for families? What is it? 35 dollars to take it? Oh, you blame everything. Yeah, and no ticket fees no convenient fees no service fees. We pay your taxes. I mean everything
segments.zh: 你怎么让家庭保持这个价格？多少钱？35美元？哦，全都包了。没有票务费、没有便利费、没有服务费。我们替你付税，全都包了。

segments.en: Mean that that's our model and when you make every decision buy the fans. That's why we do it and so yeah, I mean we're fortunate and even tickets are going on the secondary market for hundreds of dollars
segments.zh: 这就是我们的模式，每个决定都以粉丝为先。所以我们这么做。我们很幸运，但即使门票在二手市场卖到几百美元……

segments.en: So we built our own secondary market and we kept every ticket at face value where we're investing hundreds of thousands of dollars in that. Because you can't just say you're going to be fans first you have to do with every single thing that you do
segments.zh: 所以我们建了自己的二手市场，每张票都保持面值，为此投入数十万美元。因为不能只说粉丝优先，必须在每件事上做到。

segments.en: And we've been trying to do that since day one and the fans certainly have every paid us and showed up more than we could ever imagine
segments.zh: 我们从第一天起就努力这样做，粉丝们确实回报了我们，到场人数超出我们想象。
